plans.idea: Faithful centered poster: a narrow centered text column forces the headline to break as in the original ("Sparkle slowly. / Sip at sunset.") with large type and the small tracked subhead beneath, surrounded by generous dark negative space.

Left-aligned banner: the two-line headline and subhead sit flush-left on a shared edge in the left ~58% of the canvas so the eye reads left to right, leaving deliberate open space at right for balance.
Wide single-line statement: a full-width, shorter text band lets the headline run as one confident line across the banner with the subhead centered directly below it, true to a wide-format read.
